heroHeadline: Riyadh Airport Toll Rises to 12 Dead, 300+ Injured; Houthis Declare All Saudi Airports Valid Targets
heroSubtitle: Revised casualty figures from the Houthi missile strike on King Khalid International Airport reveal at least 12 killed and over 300 injured. The Houthis have now declared all Saudi airports legitimate military targets except sites near Islamic holy places, as Saudi Arabia weighs its strategic response.
footerNote: Data sourced from Saudi Press Agency, Al Jazeera, Reuters, AP, Washington Post, Bloomberg, NBC News, CNN, NPR, ABC News (Australia), TASS, Türkiye Today, Anadolu Agency, News.Az, Yemen Monitor, Arab News, The Hindu, UN OCHA, UN News, World Health Organization, Security Council Report, CFR Global Conflict Tracker, Trading Economics, and the US Senate Armed Services Committee record. Contested claims flagged with opposing perspectives.
